conditional_findings.first_contract: A distance report must preserve point, segment and area geometry after converting an admitted ground contact into the property frame.
conditional_findings.source_witness: Assume an axis-aligned unit collision cuboid centred at architectural origin with collision-bounds centre zero; its plane contact is an area square with x,z in [-0.5,0.5]. Under IEEE f32 round-to-nearest, let the building and property x centres be 2^25 metres, both orientations identity. Adding either x offset ±0.5 rounds to 2^25; the subsequent subtraction leaves four retained contact vertices on x=0, with z=±0.5. Assume the accepted fixed-post rectangle in the property frame has corners (0,2),(8,2),(8,3),(0,3). It is separated by at least 1.5 metres in z. contains(contact,(0,2)) computes all cross-product sides as zero, returns true for its four-vertex collapsed input, and distance::between therefore returns 0. This is a symbolic source and f32 reasoning example; no contact, plan, diagnostic or product was executed.
conditional_findings.counterevidence: GroundContact itself classifies empty, point, segment and nondegenerate area before the later transform; actual Point and Segment produce one or two vertices and do not enter contains as a polygon. The regular selected source is generated by the building compiler, and the complete scene, post layout and earlier geometry checks may prevent this combination. The report explicitly disclaims final foundation and collision certification.
conditional_findings.effect_and_limits: If a supported generated area contact is rounded into the stated degenerate geometry and the stated post reaches this diagnostic, its closest-post gap can report zero for separated represented contacts. No supported full producer, actual scene, generated report, physical collision or user impact has been established.
conditional_findings.repair_direction: When authorized, preserve or re-admit contact dimensionality after frame conversion and compute distance for point, segment or area without requiring legitimate tangencies to have positive area. Check source precision, post geometry and all report consumers.
conditional_findings.alias_qualification: Original059 question is partially resolved by a new conditional current source example. The separately recorded rounded floor-polygon topology issue has a different consumer and failure; related, not asserted an exact alias. No checkpoint3821 finding inferred.
